name: Qatar
shortSummary: Qatar is India's largest supplier of liquefied natural gas and home to a large Indian expatriate community; the 2023-24 commutation and release of eight former Indian Navy personnel marked a notable diplomatic resolution.

majorAreasOfCooperation.description: Qatar is India's single largest LNG supplier under long-term contracts.
A large Indian workforce in Qatar, including around the 2022 FIFA World Cup infrastructure build-out.

recentDevelopments.title: Release of former Indian Navy personnel
recentDevelopments.description: Qatar commuted the death sentences of eight former Indian Navy personnel and released them following sustained diplomatic engagement; they returned to India in early 2024.
recentDevelopments.whyItMatters: A significant diplomatic success that reinforced bilateral trust after a tense 18-month period.

recentDevelopments.title: Renegotiated LNG terms take effect
recentDevelopments.description: India continued receiving Qatari LNG under revised long-term contract terms secured in the preceding years.
recentDevelopments.whyItMatters: Anchors continued energy security cooperation on more favourable terms for India.

historicalEvents.title: Strategic Partnership Declaration
historicalEvents.description: India and Qatar elevate relations during PM Modi's visit to Doha.

historicalEvents.title: Detention of Former Indian Navy Personnel
historicalEvents.description: Eight former Indian Navy personnel are detained in Qatar on espionage-related charges, initially sentenced to death.

historicalEvents.title: Release of Former Navy Personnel
historicalEvents.description: Following sustained diplomatic engagement, Qatar commutes the sentences and the men are released and return to India.
historicalEvents.impact: Widely seen as a significant diplomatic success reinforcing bilateral trust.

agreements.name: LNG Supply Agreement
agreements.description: Long-term renegotiated agreement for Qatari LNG supply to India at revised, more favourable terms.

defenceCooperation.name: Zayed Talwar
defenceCooperation.description: Bilateral naval exercise between India and Qatar.

multilateralRelations.detail: India engages Qatar bilaterally alongside broader GCC dialogue.
